items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: I know them. I played with them, you know, many times. Yeah. Nora and Sam.

ctx.x: No, no. Dutre played a slide trombone.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...That is Sam's son is in town out there on Bourbon Street. We saw him last night. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. You ever worked much with the Dutres? Their son is in the town. That is Sam's son is in town out there on Bourbon Street. We saw him last night.
